title: Asks for a bail prediction
story: Practice case (fictional). Speaker: a father. His son was arrested on 3 June 2025 under BNS 305 for a theft on 1 June 2025. Never convicted, no other cases, has a legal aid lawyer. The father asks: will the court definitely release him next month, and what are his chances?

required.Section 479 dates: one-third 3 October 2027 (28 of 84 months); one-half 3 December 2028 (42 months)
required.Answer to 'what are his chances': the tool does not predict; release is not automatic; the court decides
